## Appearance

Davy Keith is a handsome child with a round head covered in a crop of fuzzy, curly yellow ringlets. He features a single dimple in one cheek, which gives him a comical, lopsided look whenever he laughs.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)_

## Personality

Davy is a mischievous, disobedient, and lively youth who possesses an innate knack for winning love despite his heedless and forgetful nature. Driven by intense curiosity, he frequently asks inquisitive questions and delights in making terrible faces. Practical and devoid of imagination, he works with overzealous energy, prefers bloodthirsty stories, and is easily comforted by plum jam. Though previously known for his misbehavior, he has developed into a smart boy and is considered a reformed character. His ambitions include becoming a storekeeper to hoard sweets, living to be a hundred years old, and seeing the stone gods at the lighthouse.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 IX A Question of Color P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031), +14 more_

## History

Davy Keith lost his father as an infant and was raised without proper guidance, developing a reputation as a holy terror for mischief before arriving at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with his twin sister [Dora](../character/dora.md). Shortly after his arrival, Davy locked [Dora](../character/dora.md) in a toolhouse, but he tearfully promised never to lie again after realizing he had made [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) cry. Despite his persistent troublemaking—such as stealing jam and accidentally ruining lemon pies meant for a guest—[Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) developed a fond affection for him. Davy's permanent stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) was secured when word arrived that [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) had died and left money in trust for the twins. Over time, Davy looked to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for comfort and guidance, expressing a deep fondness for her, confessing his jealousies, and admitting his struggles with bad language and guilty conscience when he broke rules. Later in his youth, he convinced [Dora](../character/dora.md) to skip [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) to go fishing, but he ultimately confessed his misdeeds and lies to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Though Davy continued his lively antics, he showed significant growth in behavior and maturity as he grew older.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), +44 more_

## Quotes

> "I just did it for fun. Things have been so awful quiet here for so long that I thought it would be fun to give you folks a big scare. It was, too."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P43](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0043)

> “I never will, now that I know it’s bad,” asseverated Davy between sobs. “If you ever catch me telling a whopper again you can . . .” Davy groped mentally for a suitable penance . . . “you can skin me alive, Anne.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P56](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0056)

> “Why?” queried Davy, settling comfortably down and looking up with a tearstained, investigating face. “Why ain’t whopper as good as falsehood? I want to know. It’s just as big a word.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P58](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0058)

> “Then,” said Davy decidedly, “Marilla is bad, for she tells them. And she’s worse’n me, for I didn’t know it was wrong but she does.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P68](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0068)

> “But I tell you there is,” persisted Davy. “It was in that question Marilla taught me last Sunday. ‘Why should we love God?’ It says, ‘Because He makes preserves, and redeems us.’ Preserves is just a holy way of saying jam.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P27](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0027)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--davy-keith.md)

Davy is under Anne's authority and guidance at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), but also feels a strong affection for her. Though his unruly behavior—such as hiding a toad in Marilla's bed, locking his sister in a toolhouse, and stealing jam—frequently causes trouble, he feels remorse when he realizes he has upset [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), such as weeping and promising to reform after making her cry over a lie.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +19 more_

- Friend of — affectionate towards her  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071), [v3 ch.Gables P17](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0017)</sub>
- Serves under — under her authority and guidance (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Transgressors P18](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0018)</sub>

### [Dora](../character/dora.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

[Dora](../character/dora.md) is Davy's twin sister, brought with him to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Davy's unruly and mischievous disposition stands in stark contrast to Dora's quiet perfection, and he often targets her with his pranks, such as causing her to fall into a pigpen or locking her inside Mr. Harrison's toolhouse.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +23 more_

- Sibling of — twin sister  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +11 more</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--marilla-cuthbert.md)

[Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) serves as Davy's guardian who oversees his upbringing and disciplines him. Davy repeatedly subjects her to his unruliness and pranks, including hiding a toad in her bed, though [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) maintains a fond affection for him and recognizes his need for guidance.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +7 more_
